guitar.evidence: Bashung was primarily a singer/songwriter who worked with rotating session and touring guitarists (e.g. various French studio players over decades); no single iconic guitar associated with him personally.
guitar.notes: Original entry is reasonable and conservative; kept as-is.

tone.target: jangly chorus-clean with dotted delay sheen
tone.profile: jangly chorus-clean with dotted delay sheen
tone.summary: A sparkling, jangly rhythm tone built around a clean preamp (US Deluxe/Silver Twin), enhanced by Chorus for width and Digital Delay for rhythmic sheen. The overall sound is bright and airy.

rig.name: Alain Bashung - Osez Joséphine - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Slightly push the clean signal for audible attack and brightness.
blocks.gap: The 'Boost' module is used to simulate a gentle, transparent boost rather than an aggressive overdrive, fitting the 'clean edge' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Keep the signal clean and transparent to maintain jangle.
blocks.gap: No drive module is needed; keeping it bypassed ensures maximum clarity for the chorus effect.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, clean Fender-style foundation suitable for jangly tones.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the best choice to emulate the desired Vox/Fender clean sound profile.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright and focused cabinet sound matching the US Deluxe amp.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is selected for its inherent brightness, complementing the clean tone requirement.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the high end and brightness to achieve a 'bright jangle' sound.
blocks.gap: Used for surgical tone shaping, boosting the upper harmonics necessary for jangly guitar sounds.

blocks.purpose: Add width and movement to the clean signal, fulfilling the 'chorus' requirement.
Create the rhythmic 'dotted delay sheen' required for the tone.
blocks.gap: The settings are tuned to simulate a dotted eighth note feel (approx. 300ms) with moderate feedback.

blocks.purpose: Add light ambience and space without muddying the jangly clarity.
blocks.gap: A subtle Room reverb is chosen over Plate/Spring to provide a natural, airy sense of space.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better match the bright, clean jangle tone.

proposals.reason: Enhance clarity and brightness for jangly tones.
